title: Enterprise Management Incentives (EMI): simplification of the process to grant options
text:
The measure simplifies the administration of Enterprise Management Incentives ( EMI ). Companies will no longer need to tell HMRC separately when they grant their employees EMI options.

 Instead, a company will be required to report details of the grant of options through the existing EMI annual return. 

 The changes apply to options granted on or after 6 April 2027.

 The draft legislation which is being published on 13 July 2026, is open for technical consultation until 7 September 2026. Send any comments to the Employment Income Policy mailbox email employmentincomepolicy@hmrc.gov.uk  for the attention of Anne Berriman.
changeNote: From on or after 6 April 2027 changes apply to Enterprise Management Incentives (EMI) options granted. The 'Background to the measure' section has been updated to confirm the draft legislation about the EMI options was published for technical consultation on 13 July 2026 as part of Legislation Day. Changes to the EMI options have been added to the sections 'Proposed revisions' and 'Administrative impact on business including civil society organisations'. The exchequer impact table has been updated for Budget 2026.
